_note: v4 findings catalog. A finding is ESTABLISHED when it has 3 independent sources (or all its sources, if it lists fewer than 3). Only established findings go on the board. 'need' = sources required. 'name' is the conclusion: the game only shows it once the finding is established. Until then it shows 'leads': what each source actually showed you, in plain words, with no conclusions drawn.

findings.name: Pryce died around 21:40, before the music box played
findings.text: The thermometer, the stiffness and the settled blood all point to about twenty to ten: after he bolted his door at 21:25, and before the tune at ten.
